en: Fixed screen reader mode: search boxes now say "Search:" instead of a symbol VoiceOver read as "telephone recorder", and highlighted prompt text, such as Ctrl+R search matches and "ultrathink", no longer has spaces inside words
zh: 修复了屏幕阅读器模式：搜索框现在会读出“Search:”，而不是 VoiceOver 读作“telephone recorder”的符号；高亮的 prompt 文本（如 Ctrl+R 搜索匹配项和“ultrathink”）不再在单词内部出现空格
